column4: Okay, let's get started. The goal today is to agree on the onboarding metrics for the next quarter.
Before we do that, I want to flag that the activation numbers from last month look off.
The dashboard counts trial accounts twice, so activation looks about ten percent higher than it really is.
I can confirm that. I traced it yesterday. The join in the staging model duplicates rows when an account upgrades.
So should we pause the weekly report until it's fixed? Finance is reading it every Monday.
I would rather ship the fix this week and add a note to the report in the meantime.
That works for me. Let's add the note today and review the fix on Thursday.
I'll write the note and send it to finance after this meeting.
Great, and I will update the onboarding metric definitions in the doc.
Perfect. Thanks everyone, that's all for today.
